tasks.name: In-app notifications with variable-substitution templates
tasks.summary: Create notification_templates and notifications tables; emit in-app notifications on booking confirmed, payment success/failure, and check-in events with template variable substitution.
tasks.details: Template variables: bookingNo, movieTitle, showtime, guestName, roomNo, etc. (CORE-OPS-004). Notification service substitutes variables at creation time. Admin can update templates affecting future messages only. User can mark notifications read. Page 6.
acceptanceCriteria: Booking confirmed event creates notification with correct variable values
Template change affects future notifications, not existing ones
User can mark notifications read; unread count visible in header
steps: Create notification_templates and notifications tables
Implement TemplateRenderer with Mustache/simple token substitution
Publish NotificationEvent from booking/payment/check-in services
Write NotificationService subscriber creating notification rows
Angular notification bell polling GET /notifications/unread-count

tasks.name: File metadata storage with type/size validation and object-storage upload
tasks.summary: Store file metadata (originalFilename, storageKey, MIME, size, domain, entityId, uploadedBy) separately from object storage; validate file type and size before accepting upload.
tasks.details: file_metadata table referenced by movie posters, hotel images, PDFs (CORE-OPS-005 to CORE-OPS-008). Movie/hotel images accept allowed image MIME types; PDFs accepted for specific document fields. Size limit configurable per file category. Files listable and downloadable by permission. Return 422 with reason on invalid upload. Page 7.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload with disallowed MIME type returns 422 validation error
Upload exceeding size limit returns 422 with size constraint message
Uploaded file metadata queryable by domain and entityId
Files downloadable by users with appropriate permission
steps: Create file_metadata table
Implement FileValidationService checking MIME whitelist and size cap
Write POST /files/upload multipart endpoint storing to object storage and inserting metadata
Expose GET /files?domain=&entityId= and GET /files/:id/download
Integrate with movie poster and hotel image upload flows

tasks.name: Movie CRUD with status lifecycle and deletion guard
tasks.summary: Cinema manager creates/updates movies with DRAFT → COMING_SOON → NOW_SHOWING → ENDED lifecycle; delete is blocked when showtimes reference the movie.
tasks.details: Required fields before public display: title, durationMinutes, releaseDate, ageRating, language, status, poster. Poster optional in DRAFT. Status ENDED cannot be used for new future showtimes. DELETE returns 409 with showtime count if any showtime references the movie. Support advanced list search: by title, genre, status, language, age rating, release date with server-side pagination. Page 7-8.
acceptanceCriteria: Movie saved as DRAFT with optional poster
Transition to COMING_SOON/NOW_SHOWING requires poster
DELETE returns 409 dependency message with showtime count when showtimes exist
ENDED movie cannot be scheduled for new future showtimes
Movie list paginated and filterable by all listed criteria
steps: Create movies table with status enum column
Implement status transition validation in MovieService
Add DELETE guard: count showtimes by movieId, reject if > 0
Write movie list endpoint with dynamic JPA Specification filters
Build Angular movie list with filter bar and status chips

tasks.name: Cinema branches, screening rooms, and seat layout generator
tasks.summary: Manage cinema branches and rooms; generate seat layout from row/column config; restrict layout changes after future sold tickets exist.
tasks.details: Branch: code, name, address, city, contact, opening/closing time, status. Room: roomCode, roomName, type, capacity, status, belongs to active branch. Seat layout generator accepts row labels, column count, seat type mapping, blocked/aisle positions. Individual seat edits allowed (type, blocked, position) while safe. Layout change blocked if any future showtime has active hold or sold ticket — return dependency error. Seat preview shows rows, columns, VIP/standard/blocked legend. Page 8-9.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated seat count matches layout configuration input
Seat map preview updates immediately after config change
Layout change with active hold/sold ticket returns dependency error
Room must belong to active branch
Inactive branch cannot create new showtimes
steps: Create cinema_branches and screening_rooms tables
Create seats table with rowLabel, colNumber, seatType, isBlocked, showtimeSeatId FK
Implement SeatLayoutGeneratorService from row/col/type config
Add layout-change guard: check future showtime active holds and sold tickets
Build Angular SeatBuilderComponent with visual grid preview

tasks.name: Showtime creation with end-time calculation and room-overlap prevention
tasks.summary: Create showtimes generating showtime seats from room layout; compute end time as start + duration + cleaning buffer; reject if room schedule overlaps including buffer.
tasks.details: Required: movie, branch, room, start time, price config, sale window. End time = start + durationMinutes + cleaningBufferMinutes (configurable). Overlap check includes active showtimes AND cleaning buffer. Creating a showtime copies room seats into showtime_seats table. UI previews end time before save. Page 9.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating showtime generates showtime_seats from room seats
UI previews calculated end time before save
Overlapping showtime (including cleaning buffer) cannot be saved
Showtime form filters rooms belonging to selected branch
steps: Create showtimes and showtime_seats tables
Implement end-time calculator using configurable cleaning buffer
Add overlap query: SELECT 1 FROM showtimes WHERE room_id=? AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED') AND NOT (endTime <= newStart OR startTime >= newEnd)
On showtime create, bulk-insert showtime_seats from room seats
Build Angular showtime form with real-time end-time preview

tasks.name: Bulk showtime creation, cancellation, and update restrictions
tasks.summary: Generate repeated showtime schedules by date range/weekdays/time slots; cancel with booking impact evaluation; restrict core field edits after paid tickets.
tasks.details: Bulk create: date range, weekday selection, time slots — validate each generated slot for overlap and report invalid rows with reason. Cancellation: if paid tickets exist, those bookings become refund candidates. After paid tickets, movie/room/time fields are locked; update requires cancel+recreate flow. Showtime statuses: SCHEDULED, SELLING, SOLD_OUT, CANCELLED, COMPLETED. Page 9.
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk generation reports each invalid slot with reason instead of silently skipping
Cancelled showtime no longer sellable; tickets cannot check in
Movie/room/time fields disabled in UI after paid tickets; backend enforces same restriction
Showtime status reflects sale window, seat availability, and time progression
steps: Implement BulkShowtimeGeneratorService iterating date range × weekdays × slots
Collect validation errors per slot and return partial-success response
Add cancellation flow: set status CANCELLED, mark tickets CANCELLED, flag bookings for refund
Add update guard: if paid tickets exist, reject changes to movie/room/startTime
Angular calendar view grouping showtimes by date with status color coding

tasks.name: Showtime seat map display, seat selection, and temporary hold with Redis lock
tasks.summary: Display live seat map with AVAILABLE/HELD/SOLD/BLOCKED status; create temporary seat hold with TTL using Redis distributed lock and DB unique constraint to prevent duplicates.
tasks.details: Seat map statuses: AVAILABLE, HELD, SOLD, BLOCKED. Sold/blocked/held-by-other seats are disabled. Default TTL 5 minutes (configurable). Hold stores customer, showtime, seats, expiry. Prevent duplicates using Redis SET NX lock per showtimeSeatId + DB unique constraint. Limit one active hold per user/showtime. Hold response: holdId, expiresAt, selected seats. Page 10.
acceptanceCriteria: Seat map accurately reflects current status on load
Parallel requests for same seat result in exactly one success
No duplicate active hold for same customer and showtime
Hold response includes holdId and expiresAt
Customer cannot proceed without at least one available seat selected
steps: Create seat_holds and seat_hold_items tables with unique constraint on (showtime_id, customer_id, status=ACTIVE)
Add unique index on showtime_seats for concurrent hold protection
Implement Redis SETNX lock per showtimeSeatId before DB insert
Write POST /cinema/holds endpoint returning HoldResponseDto
Angular seat-map component disabling unavailable seats

tasks.name: Hold expiry cleanup and near-real-time seat map refresh
tasks.summary: Scheduled job expires held seats and makes them available; WebSocket or polling pushes seat status updates to active seat-map viewers.
tasks.details: Expired holds: set hold status EXPIRED, mark showtime_seats back to AVAILABLE. Scheduler runs every minute (configurable). WebSocket preferred for real-time push; polling acceptable fallback. Creating a new hold auto-cancels expired previous hold for same user/showtime. Page 10-11.
acceptanceCriteria: Expired hold returns HOLD_EXPIRED error on checkout attempt
Seat map refreshes to show newly available seats within acceptable latency
Another user releasing seats updates map visible to concurrent viewers
steps: Spring @Scheduled job: UPDATE seat_holds SET status=EXPIRED WHERE expires_at < NOW()
Update showtime_seats status back to AVAILABLE on expiry
Implement WebSocket topic /topic/showtimes/{showtimeId}/seats broadcasting status delta
Angular seat-map subscribes to WebSocket; fallback to 30s polling if WS unavailable
Add HOLD_EXPIRED guard in booking creation service
